newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sees January trade deficit at $420 mln.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sees January trade deficit at $420 mln.

text.p: Vietnam's General Statistics Office said on Wednesday it expected a month-end trade deficit of $420 million for January.
An official said exports were seen reaching $580 million and imports $1.0 billion. Corresponding data for January 1996 was not available.
However, the official added that the figures represented a 15.3 percent year-on-year rise in exports and a 6.3 percent decrease in the value of imported goods.
Vietnam's trade deficit rose to a record $4.0 billion last year from 1995's $2.2 billion as the growing economy sucked in imports faster than it could produce goods for sale abroad.
The issue has become a major policy concern for government and has prompted calls in some quarters to promote local products over imports and stirred debate over the merits of embracing free trade.
